generation.explanation: A line of best fit (least-squares regression) chooses slope m and intercept b to minimize the sum of squared vertical distances from each data point to the line. The formulas are m = Σ(x−x̄)(y−ȳ) / Σ(x−x̄)² and b = ȳ − m·x̄, and R² measures how much of the variance in y the line explains. Drag any of the blue points and the regression line, its equation, and R² update in real time. Toggle 'Show residuals' to see the exact vertical errors being minimized, or hit 'Randomize points' for a fresh dataset.
